document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
A  bolt  of  freezing  energy  streaks  over  your  head. The  dank 
stone wall behind you shatters and chunks of ice-covered rock 
rain down. You feel the temperature of your hiding place fall 
20  degrees.  You  peer  outside.  Several  of  the  pink  creatures 
waddle through the undergrowth toward you. Another raises 
its weapon and fires. Your face and fingers begin to freeze.
In a few minutes, the cave will be impossibly cold.

If you are armed, you may try to drive off the aliens with gunfire: go 
to 517. To make a run for it, go to 330.
